parameters.jsCode: const notice=$input.first().json; const draft=$('Validate LLM Draft').first().json; const approval=$('Request Shared Approval').first().json; const notificationOk=notice.ok===true; return [{json:{ok:notificationOk,status:notificationOk?'pending_approval':'pending_approval_notice_failed',correlationId:draft.correlationId,testMode:draft.testMode,draftOnly:draft.draftOnly,approvalKey:draft.approvalKey,approvalExpiresAt:approval.request?.expiresAt??null,pendingStored:draft.testMode===false,intent:draft.intent,summary:draft.summary,draftReply:draft.replyText,ownerNotification:{status:notice.status??'failed',ok:notificationOk},externalReply:false}}];

nodes.name: Enforce Exact Approval and Prepare Reply

parameters.jsCode:
const approval=$input.first().json; const resolved=$('Resolve Pending Owner Decision').first().json; const state=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const storageKey=`key:${resolved.pending.approvalKey}`; if(state.telegramAssistantPending)delete state.telegramAssistantPending[storageKey];
return [{json:{ok:approval.ok===true,status:approval.status==='denied'?'approval_denied':approval.status==='expired'?'approval_expired':'approval_failed',correlationId:resolved.pending.correlationId,testMode:resolved.testMode,draftOnly:resolved.draftOnly,approvalKey:resolved.pending.approvalKey,externalReply:false,error:approval.ok===true?null:(approval.error??{code:'APPROVAL_FAILED',message:'Approval resolution failed'})}}];

const current=$input.first().json; const error=current.error??{code:'WORKFLOW_FAILED',message:'Telegram assistant rejected the current step',retryable:false}; return [{json:{contractVersion:'1.0',testMode:current.testMode!==false,correlationId:current.correlationId??undefined,workflowKey:'business.telegram-assistant',error:{code:typeof error.code==='string'?error.code:'WORKFLOW_FAILED',message:typeof error.message==='string'?error.message:'Telegram assistant failed',retryable:error.retryable===true,httpStatus:error.httpStatus},recursionDepth:0,handledBy:[]}}];

const handled=$input.first().json; return [{json:{ok:false,status:'failed',correlationId:handled.correlationId??null,testMode:handled.testMode!==false,draftOnly:true,externalReply:false,handled:handled.handled===true,error:handled.error??{code:'WORKFLOW_FAILED',message:'Shared error handling failed'}}}];

const result=$input.first().json; let outcome='success'; if(result.status==='approval_denied')outcome='denied'; else if(result.status==='no_reply_needed'||result.status==='reply_duplicate')outcome='skipped'; else if(result.ok!==true)outcome='failure'; return [{json:{contractVersion:'1.0',testMode:result.testMode!==false,correlationId:result.correlationId,eventType:'telegram.assistant.processed',outcome,subjectRef:result.correlationId,metadata:{workflowKey:'business.telegram-assistant',actionType:result.status,channel:'telegram'}}}];

const names=['Prepare Pending Result','Prepare No Reply Result','Finalize Approved Decision','Finalize Denied or Expired Decision']; for(const name of names){const node=$(name);if(node.isExecuted)return [{json:node.first().json}];}return [{json:{ok:false,status:'failed',externalReply:false}}];

parameters.content:
## Telegram Assistant — safe demo
Native Telegram Trigger accepts only configured chats and text messages. The profile repeats the allowlist, pins owner chat/user identity, and exports with testMode=true and draftOnly=true. User content is untrusted, tools are disabled, and an exact `/approve telegram-reply-<update_id>` from the configured owner is required before the only user-reply branch. `/deny`, bot messages, duplicate updates, unknown approvals and all errors fail closed. Configure the shared LLM Gateway and Send Telegram Message workflows separately.
